_register: FR register, settled in the 2026-08-18 French review. « tu » is used only where the copy speaks directly to a prospective delegate: the home join band, /get-involved, /disciplines, and the student-facing answers in faq.json. Everything else uses « vous » — site chrome in this file and in SocialBand, because it renders on /privacy and /contact too; /privacy, /contact and /report; /donate and /sponsors, which address donors and companies; and /who-we-are, which describes JMCC in the third person and only addresses the reader in its closing CTA. faq.json deliberately carries both: a question a student asks is answered with « tu », a question a company asks is answered with « vous ». Keep new strings on the right side of that line.
_review: Reviewed 2026-08-18. Open question for the exec: « Comité des compétitions John Molson » is our own name for ourselves and is left as-is. Concordia's official French for the school is « École de gestion John-Molson », hyphenated, and Quebec convention would hyphenate ours the same way. Changing how JMCC names itself is the exec's call, not a translator's.
